_why: Config for the optional workflow commands (--with-workflow-commands). The commands read THIS file so the same command code works on any project. Fill in your own ids/hosts; put SECRETS in environment variables named here, never inline. Any command whose required config is absent must say so and stop — it must not invent ids or run against the wrong workspace.

notion.note: Prefer the REST API with $NOTION_TOKEN over the Notion MCP for freshness; the MCP can serve a stale cache.

shortcut.link_convention: Mentioning sc-<story_id> in a PR title/body auto-links Shortcut<->GitHub when the integration is enabled.

slop_check.note: External design-slop detector. If the binary is absent the command is a no-op and says so.
